sources: Batch 4 (docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0026_lastrite.md, its kit plan and the section 'Kit (2026-10-21)'). Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0026_lastrite_* via efsim kit-draft, checked by hand; BuffData buff_chr_0026_lastrite_normal_skill (Hypothermic Perfusion), _normal_skill_main_start, _normal_skill_inattack, _normal_skill_self, _normal_skill_tag, _normal_skill_phantom(_main), _talent_1(_vul), _passive; values SkillPatchTable, SkillData defaults (battle skill atk_up 0.2, poise 5, potential_1), PotentialTalentEffectTable.
Talent indices: 0 is Hypothermia (buff_chr_0026_lastrite_talent_1: crystal_up 0.02 / 0.04, duration 15), 1 is Cryogenic Embrittlement (sets the ultimate's talent_2 to 1 and rate 1.2 / 1.5).

Potentials (loader, from the data): P1 potential_1 = 1 (the perfusion's +atk_up DMG and +poise Stagger on Final Strikes), P2 Strength +20 and Cryo DMG +10% (stat panel), P3 ×1.15 on the combo's atk_scale / atk_scale2 / atk_scale3 and the ultimate's atk_scale / atk_scale2, P4 ultimate cost ×0.85, P5 battle skill atb +5 and atk_scale ×1.2 (the Mirages).

Left out: the dash attack (chr_0026_lastrite_dash_attack has a SkillPatchTable row but no SkillData in the checkout; batch-3 S5), hit-stops and the combo's 2 s enemy freeze (buff_chr_0026_lastrite_combo_skill_hitstop, time scale 0 on the enemy: Ti1b), the combo's frame-63 energy fallback when the target died at frame 13 (no kills in the engine), damage immunity during the ultimate (enemy damage isn't simulated).

buffs.label: Only her own battle and combo skills give her Ultimate Energy
buffs.note: buff_chr_0026_lastrite_passive (lifeType 1): RefrainObtainUsp with refrainObtainUspTags 264623624. Her own ObtainCostAction usp grants carry useUspRecoverTag 264623624 and pass: written as energy actions with ignoreBlock. Team energy (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp) and gear-set energy are blocked for her.

buffs.label: Hypothermic Perfusion
buffs.note: buff_chr_0026_lastrite_normal_skill, created by buff_..._normal_skill_self on CharacterTeamFinder (every member), `duration` 15 s, stackingType 2 max 1. P1: its damageModifier (CheckMainCharacterCondition, CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 1 mask 2097152, CompareFloat potential_1 = 1) → DamageScaleProcessor NormalCalcZone +atk_up on the holder's Final Strikes while controlled (batch-4 C3). potential_1 is 0 below P1 (SkillData default) and 1 from P1 (PotentialTalentEffectTable). The first holder's use ends it for the whole team: trigger mirage (the owner's call, 2026-10-25: one Mirage pair per cast; the data's _tag would end only that holder's, batch-4 B6). It ends at once after that Final Strike's first landing, so a Final Strike with several landings gets P1's +20% on the first only.

buffs.label: Hypothermia: Cryo Susceptibility
buffs.note: VulnerableAction subType 5 (Cryo), rate crystal_vul = infliction_num × crystal_up (SimpleCalcBB in buff_..._talent_1), asChildBuff (logged as buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_crystal); stackingType 1, priority crystal_vul, max 1: the strongest instance acts (loader, batch-3 B1). Verified on b7b3 (0.16 = 4 × 0.04 at t=11462 as a boundary buff, active at 15280). Its instances rank by crystal_vul (the game buff's priority key), which buff_chr_0026_lastrite_talent_1 computes as infliction_num × crystal_up and passes at creation: the effect's value.

triggers.note: COMBO TRIGGER: "When an enemy has {count} or more Cryo Infliction stacks" (count 3 at every level).

dataOverride.energy: A beside cast plays no timeline: the game runs its switchToBuffConfig buff (normal_skill_inattack), whose start grants the energy; the data's 32 and 300 are the timeline's two paths (see the trigger's note).

triggers.note: Cast inside her own basic attack while controlled (KitSkill.beside): the game runs buff_..._normal_skill_inattack instead of the timeline (switchToBuffConfig asSkillCast), whose start event ends the perfusion (FinishBuffAdvanced), creates buff_..._normal_skill_self (the perfusion on every member and ObtainCostAction atb, atbGainMethod 1: returned SP), buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp (team energy: at the cast for a beside cast) and ObtainCostAction usp with her tag. SP kind from the data (batch-4 D2).

Controlled path (no jump at 0): buff_..._normal_skill_main_start, created at f6 (finishWithNextSkillIfNotInherited, so not detached), at its frame 26 = skill frame 32: FinishBuff _tag, CreateBuff _self (the perfusion and the returned atb), buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp (teamEnergy at 32) and ObtainCostAction usp with her tag. The jump 187 → 429 skips frame 300.

Not-controlled path: JumpToAction 0 → 300 (NotNextCheckAction + CheckMainCharacterCondition: she isn't controlled), so frame 300 comes at the cast: FinishBuff _tag, CreateBuff _self, buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp (teamEnergy at 300), ObtainCostAction usp with her tag, LaunchProjectile (its projhit file is empty).

hits.label: Mirage
hits.note: buff_..._normal_skill_phantom (another holder) at its frame 9: as mirage_main_1.

triggers.note: The perfusion's abilityEvent 302 (the holder deals damage): [CheckHp, the 0.1 s marker, Final Strike mask 2097152, holder controlled] → IfElse CheckTagMatch 264623624 on the holder → buff_..._phantom_main else _phantom on the target, then _tag on the holder, which in the data ends that holder's perfusion only (abilityEvent 9; batch-4 B6). Here the first Final Strike while controlled by any holder ends it for the whole team (endBuff without `to`): one Mirage pair per cast, the owner's call (2026-10-25: "the battle skill can only be activated once"), which b6aa's log supports (one pair after Arcane's Final Strike, none after Si's 4.6 s later). batch-4 C2 operatorBuff. `controlled` here is the owner: she is controlled exactly when she is the hitter (by: controlled). The Mirages are her trigger hits (her stats): the phantom buffs are hers, on the enemy; no log has them yet (report row 14).

triggers.note: Frame 13: SaveBuffStackNumByTag (Cryo Infliction, tag 1570888476) → infliction_num; ObtainCostAction usp_base, and (IfElse CheckHp > 0) usp × infliction_num, both with her tag: 40 + 15 × n. The frame-63 fallback (usp × min(n, 4) when recover_usp = 0, i.e. the target died at frame 13) isn't written.
